about_the_game:
Life 2047: Escape Simulator is an atmospheric game with elements of arcade and stealth, set in a cyberpunk dystopia. Here, every step forward is a struggle against a system that watches, punishes, and repeats.

Every morning — the same room. The same line. The same faces. You move forward, but it feels like you're standing still. What is this? A simulation? A punishment? Or part of someone’s plan?

THE LINE AS CORE GAMEPLAY

Advance, earn points, and use them to get closer to the exit. Every step costs resources. Every hesitation might cost you everything.

MINI-GAMES THAT OFFER A CHANCE

Hack the system, solve puzzles, pass reaction-based challenges — each success may break the loop… or trigger retaliation. Follow instructions or disrupt the order? Obey or resist?
Every choice affects the world and brings you closer to one of several endings.

SURVEILLANCE AND CONTROL

Cameras, drones, enforcer bots — the system sees everything. Any deviation from the pattern is dangerous. Stay unnoticed if you want to survive.

A WORLD OF SOVIET CYBERPUNK

Panel buildings, endless bureaucratic corridors, flickering terminals, and public announcements echoing from the past. Only this past now belongs to machines.

A STORY FILLED WITH SECRETS

The system leaves traces — codes, encrypted messages, interface glitches, fragments of dialogue. All of it part of a larger puzzle that only you can solve.

You're not the first to be trapped in this world. But maybe — just maybe — you'll be the last.

short_description: Life 2047: Escape Simulator is an atmospheric puzzle game set in a cyberpunk dystopia. The line is your path to freedom. Hack the system, evade surveillance, uncover hidden truths, and escape the loop where every day repeats. Are you a glitch — or salvation?
